about: A design tool that keeps a design system as variables, by collection and mode. A person brings the variables in as a file, which the bridge in reads into one candidate direction; its server in a session only tells the setup step that it is there, since it gives a flat map of one frame in one mode and is no way to bring a system in.
sends: The file key and node ids, to Figma under the person's account, when read through its MCP server; the file path sends nothing.
machine: For the .fig path: the right to save the file to this machine (File > Save local copy, which the person's seat must allow), and a .fig reader the person runs themself, which leaves the file's variables as JSON. The reader that was tried is the designos-fig crate of design-os-studio (at a26f09a), under the PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 licence, which the person reads before running it; reading a .fig file decodes a format its maker does not publish, so a reader may break when the format changes. The plugin does not bundle, download, build or call any reader.

ways.how: In Figma, save the file to this machine (File > Save local copy), which gives a .fig file. Run a .fig reader yourself to export its variables as JSON in the shape of the REST endpoint for local variables (meta.variables and meta.variableCollections), and hand that JSON to bring-in. The .fig file stays on the machine: it never enters a repository.
In Figma, export the variables with its own export, which gives a folder of .tokens.json files, one for each collection and mode.
ways.not_read: The bridge does not read that folder yet: it reads one file at a time and does not take the mode from the name the export gives it, so light and dark cannot be told apart there.
